capabilities: Builds a visual index from selected notes and linked folders
Organizes records into Libraries and nested Collections
Creates notes from templates and attaches files
Surfaces smart queues for placeholders, inbox, and pinned records
Exports and imports portable organization packages
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian .base file or a saved Workspace layout; it stores its organization in plugin data.
extras: Local-first with no accounts or telemetry; online cover URLs are not loaded. Back up the complete vault and plugin data before upgrading. Physical iPhone/iPad and two-device Sync testing is not fully verified.
problem: Obsidian notes can be scattered across folders with no separate way to group and order them without moving or rewriting files.

relations.evidence: Install BRAT, run BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing
The plugin exposes ten fixed Obsidian URL actions. An Apple Shortcut

summary: Configurable visual index and organization layer for Obsidian notes, with Libraries, Collections, queues, templates, and portable exports.
